Resolves #20532

The seven comparison guides no longer open with "a comprehensive JavaScript ecosystem". Each opens with what Neo.mjs is, written for the page it is on: the Body as a multi-threaded Application Engine (where the code runs, what ships with it), then the second hemisphere in one paragraph (the Agent OS and the Neural Link) with a link to the Introduction. The overview carries the full two-hemisphere identity and loses its 2025 note about a language model. Nothing below the openings changed.

Evidence: L1 (docs; the two repository checks the ticket names, run locally and by the pre-commit hook) → L1 required (AC-1 to AC-3). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 no "comprehensive JavaScript ecosystem", no "framework" for Neo, the identity leads | outside-CI at `bb73ca7f`: a case-insensitive `grep -n` for `comprehensive`, `ecosystem`, `SPAs`, `single-page` and `paramount` over `learn/comparisons/*.md` → 14 lines, each read: none sits in an opening and none defines Neo.mjs. `grep -ci framework` → 13 lines, each read: they name Angular, Ext.js, Next.js, frameworks in general, or the section heading. The seven openings are the diff. |
| AC-2 conviction and the Ext.js parity claim kept | Source: no line below the openings changed, so `NeoVsExtJs.md` §5 is untouched. The openings keep zero runtime dependencies, the four environments and the mode without a build step, and add the capability breadth and the second hemisphere. |
| AC-3 link and whitespace integrity | outside-CI: `node buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` → OK, 352 links resolved at `bb73ca7f`; `node buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` → exit 0. Both also ran in the pre-commit hook. |

## Deltas from ticket

Three, each proposed on the ticket at intake (comment 6887182037):

- No class count in the openings. `Overview.md` links the Codebase Overview, the one counting source; the six `NeoVs*.md` openings link the Introduction only.
- `NeoVsNextJs.md` gets the identity too: the fix lists five siblings, the contract row seven.
- Each opening is written for its own page instead of one paragraph copied six times. All carry the same facts.

For the reviewer to weigh against the conviction guard: "a revolutionary zero-builds development mode" became "a development mode with no build step at all" (Angular: "the browser runs your source files as native ES modules"). The capability is stated; the adjective is gone.

One dated dependency: the openings name timeline, scheduler and Gantt views. They are on `dev` and ship with the cut planned for Nov 23. A family that misses the cut takes its word out of these lines.

Identity surface, framing only: every opening is a projection of the apex in `neomjs/neo#adr:neo-identity-source-of-truth-model`. No fact from the facts ledger changed and no generated file is touched. A cross-family review is required for this class.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the pre-commit hook ran the secrets, whitespace and relative-link checks.

## Test Evidence

No runtime behaviour. The outside-CI receipts are in the AC table. Not done: a rendered read of the seven pages in the portal.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The seven routes render on neomjs.com after the next deploy, and each generated description still fits its page.

## Commits

- `c15974fd`: the seven openings.
- `bb73ca7f`: review round 1. The Next.js page loses its second, 2025 definition of Neo.mjs and names the same capabilities as its siblings; the overview says what the Codebase Overview is.
